text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: , Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You weren't in your room, so I had a 
feeling I would find you here.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Have you already gone for your New 
Year's shrine visit? If not, would you 
care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It ended up being a late New Year's shrine 
visit, but that's still far better than 
not going at all.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Praying for an Umamusume's safety is 
also part of a Trainer's duty.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I will do everything in my power. So that 
I have no regrets later on.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If only I had done that back then. If only 
I had done more of this.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I must eliminate as many of those 
possibilities as I can. For the 
Umamusume's sake, and for my own.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I learned from the past.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But learning is never truly finished. 
For the sake of the Umamusume, I must 
constantly strive to improve.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
So that the Umamusume... those girls who 
yearn to run, can head toward the future 
they truly desire.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...I won't make the same mistake twice.

As she looked up into the high sky, I 
could sense a powerful force of will 
burning in her eyes――

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
In that sense, I suppose I owe you my 
thanks as well.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
There is much to learn from your sincere 
dedication to Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she seems to push herself too far 
sometimes...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Let us remind them whenever necessary. 
As fellow Trainers of Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>. Once again, let's both do our 
best this year――

text_block_list.name: Headband Man
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, you two over there! How about 
pounding some mochi with us?!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Huh... You mean us?

text_block_list.name: Headband Man
text_block_list.text:
Look, you can eat freshly pounded mochi 
too! Freshly made is the absolute best~!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: B-But... um...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh* Understood. You're right, since 
we have the opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
........ ...Will I be able to lift the 
mallet, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Ngh, urgh... Mmh-gggh...!!

I grabbed the wooden mallet and supported 
her as she wobbled, and we enjoyed 
pounding mochi together.

...Somehow, I felt like she and I would be 
able to grow even closer from now on.
